nature.herbcraft.hint.toxic: Toxicity sleeps within. Taste with care.
nature.herbcraft.hint.sedating: Its breath is quieting and slow.
nature.herbcraft.hint.aquatic: Watery and cool on the tongue.
nature.herbcraft.hint.fiery: Fiery and rising, warm at once.
nature.herbcraft.hint.withered: A withered aura clings to it.
nature.herbcraft.hint.nether: A Nether nature, sharp and unruly.
nature.herbcraft.hint.floral: A floral scent lifts its medicine.
nature.herbcraft.hint.fungal: Fungal and subtle, hard to predict.
nature.herbcraft.hint.lunar: Dim and cool, carrying night air.
nature.herbcraft.hint.solar: Bright and warm with a touch of sun.
nature.herbcraft.hint.leafy: Leafy and astringent, clear on first bite.
nature.herbcraft.hint.slimy: Slick by nature and hard to forget.
nature.herbcraft.hint.addictive: Calming, but it may cling back.
nature.herbcraft.hint.curio: Strange in nature; one bite is not enough.

book.herbcraft.entry.overview.title: Herbal Codex Overview
book.herbcraft.entry.overview.line1: Eating herbs is gambling; brewing potions is contract; cuisine is craft.
book.herbcraft.entry.overview.line2: Hearing reveals its nature; mastery reveals its numbers.
book.herbcraft.entry.overview.line3: Raw eating is risk, alchemy is stability, and medicinal cuisine trades preparation for cleansing, immunity, and nourishment.
book.herbcraft.entry.overview.line4: Remember: edible does not mean harmless.
message.herbcraft.herb_stack.stage_3: Bitterness curls on your tongue; the herbs begin to circle within.
message.herbcraft.herb_stack.stage_5: Potency rises; the plant nature seeps deeper.
message.herbcraft.herb_stack.stage_8: The medicine surges. Do not be greedy for another bite.
message.herbcraft.herb_stack.fade: The bitterness fades; the herb potency settles.
message.herbcraft.herb_stack.overload: Every medicine has poison. Herb potency overload!
message.herbcraft.pharmacology.harmonize: §bCold and heat harmonize; the medicine settles.
message.herbcraft.pharmacology.xiang_xu: §aMutual reinforcement: this positive effect is stronger.
message.herbcraft.pharmacology.xiang_shi: §aMutual assistance: this positive effect lasts longer.
message.herbcraft.pharmacology.xiang_sha: §bMutual detoxification: future toxic duration is reduced.
message.herbcraft.pharmacology.xiang_e: §eMutual antagonism: this medicine is weakened overall.
message.herbcraft.pharmacology.xiang_fan: §4Mutual incompatibility: this medicine fails and backfires!
